Հայոց Այբուբեն

The Armenian alphabet — 39 letters devised by Mesrop Mashtots in 405 AD, still unchanged in shape sixteen centuries on.

Pronunciation shown here follows Eastern Armenian. Western Armenian voices several consonants differently. Audio is pre-rendered from a real Armenian speech engine and embedded directly in this file, so it sounds the same everywhere and doesn't depend on voices installed on your device — though it's synthetic speech, not a human recording, so intonation can sound a little mechanical.
